title: Pearl dirt
features:
**Automation & Farming**

- **Auto Training** — Farms strength with customizable click speed, burst options, and remote execution.
- **Auto Loot** — Automatically teleports to drops, filters by rarity and sell price, and lets you adjust the scan radius.
- **Auto Sell** — Sells your backpack when it’s full. You can toggle a pause if you want to manually sort out rares.

**Progression & Upgrades**

- **Auto Rebirth** — Rebirths instantly as soon as you hit the required level.
- **Auto Upgrade** — Automatically buys upgrades (Speed, Carry, Attack Speed, Attack Range). You can toggle each one individually.
- **Auto Buy Gear** — Buys Cutters and Auras from the shop for you. Just pick from the dropdown or type in what you want.

**World & Travel**

- **Travel Worlds** — Quickly teleports you to any unlocked world (1–6). Shows the level requirement live so you don’t accidentally trigger anti-cheat.
- **Level Indicator** — Real-time display showing your current level vs. the level needed for your selected world.

**Misc**

- **Unstuck** — Instantly teleports you back to base if you get stuck in a wall or fall through the map.
- **FPS Boost** — Hides nearby grass to help performance, especially on mobile.
- **Anti-AFK** — Keeps you from getting kicked while farming.
- **Auto Rejoin** — Automatically reconnects if you get disconnected.
